info.name: Diwan API (via gateway)
info.description:
Exercises every API the gateway exposes, with assertions, including security checks (forged headers, other users' data, admin-only paths).

Setup: import this collection and the environment file, then set `lambdaSecret` to ALEXA_LAMBDA_SHARED_SECRET from the .env file. Run the folders in order (Runner, or `newman run`): it creates two users and removes them again at the end.

Rate limit: login/register allow 5 requests per IP, then about one every 12 seconds. A full run uses all 5 - wait about a minute before running it again.

item.name: Add a US stock by symbol with a first buy

exec: pm.test('country and currency come from the symbol', () => { pm.expect(h.countryCode).to.eql('US'); pm.expect(h.currency).to.eql('USD'); });
pm.test('valued from a live quote', () => { pm.expect(h.priceSource).to.eql('QUOTE'); pm.expect(h.quantity).to.eql(10); pm.expect(h.marketValue).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Arabic name and details round-trip', () => { pm.expect(h.name).to.eql('شقة التجمع الخامس'); pm.expect(h.attributes.address).to.eql('New Cairo'); });
pm.test('valued at cost until a valuation exists', () => pm.expect(h.priceSource).to.eql('COST'));

item.name: Add a valuation for the apartment

exec: pm.test('explained in Arabic', () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('transaction.exceeds_quantity'); pm.expect(e.message).to.include('تبيع'); });
pm.test('buy and sell, newest first', () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(t[0].type).to.eql('SELL'); });

item.name: Summary grouped by country, then type

exec: pm.test('grouped by country then asset type', () => pm.expect(s.groupBy).to.eql(['COUNTRY', 'ASSET_TYPE']));
pm.test('Egypt holds the apartment and the cash', () => pm.expect(eg.groups.map(g => g.key)).to.have.members(['REAL_ESTATE', 'CASH']));
pm.test('US holds the stock', () => pm.expect(s.groups.find(g => g.key === 'US').groups[0].key).to.eql('STOCK'));
pm.test('apartment gain from the valuation', () => pm.expect(eg.groups.find(g => g.key === 'REAL_ESTATE').holdings[0].unrealizedPnl).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('totals add up', () => pm.expect(s.totals.marketValue).to.be.closeTo(s.groups.reduce((a, g) => a + g.totals.marketValue, 0), 0.05));
pm.test('country and type labels are Arabic', () => { pm.expect(eg.label).to.eql('مصر'); pm.expect(eg.groups.find(g => g.key === 'REAL_ESTATE').label).to.eql('عقارات'); });

item.name: Targets that do not add up to 100 -> 400

exec: pm.test('suggestions sum to ~0 (money moves between types)', () => pm.expect(a.rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.suggestedChange, 0)).to.be.closeTo(0, 1));
pm.test('stocks are under target: buy', () => pm.expect(a.rows.find(r => r.key === 'STOCK').suggestedChange).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('only the tagged stock', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().groups.map(g => g.key)).to.eql(['US']));
